intent: kuhy sees the active focus project in i3bar: a focus_project block renders the focus field daily-limits now writes to its cache.
scope: Non-goal: no focus logic here (focus_project.status() decides); daily-limits owns the cache
changes: New block: `🎯 <name> <minutes>/<daily_minutes>`, green at the daily target, hidden with no project or a missing/stale/garbage cache; jq re-parse only on cache mtime change
Stanza has signal=11 so daily-limits can refresh it with pkill -RTMIN+11 -x i3blocks
risks: The running i3bar loads the stanza only after its next restart; until then the poke is harmless (i3blocks 1.5 survived an unconfigured RTMIN+11)
rollback: git revert the commit and remove the symlink ~/.config/i3blocks/focus_project.sh
